dudu_click.tooltip: Click event: start/stop the timer on the timer page, start/pause the pomodoro on the pomodoro page

dudu_connect_wifi.message0: Dudu clock connect WiFi timeout %1 s
dudu_connect_wifi.tooltip: Connect to the saved WiFi; on timeout clear config and reboot into provisioning mode

dudu_double_click.tooltip: Double-click event: cycle pages in order weather → air → forecast → theme → timer → pomodoro → PC monitor → reset

dudu_has_config.message0: Dudu clock has saved WiFi config?
dudu_has_config.tooltip: Check whether WiFi name, password and city are saved in NVS (returns true/false)

dudu_init.tooltip: Initialize the ST7789 screen to portrait 240x320 and load theme and saved WiFi/city config

dudu_long_press.tooltip: Long-press event: toggle theme on the theme page, zero the counter on the timer page, reset the pomodoro on the pomodoro page, factory reset and reboot on the reset page

dudu_run.message0: Dudu clock run one frame (call in loop)
dudu_run.tooltip: Main loop body: refresh time/timer/pomodoro/PC monitor for the current page, run background tasks and the portal listener; must be called repeatedly in the loop

dudu_set_api_host.tooltip: Set the QWeather dedicated API host (new accounts after 2024 look like xxx.re.qweatherapi.com, see console; empty uses the public domain). Must be called before init

dudu_set_weather_key.tooltip: Set the QWeather API key (free registration at qweather.com). Must be called before init

dudu_start_config_portal.tooltip: Start the DuduClock SoftAP hotspot with a QR code; connect with a phone and open 192.168.1.1 to configure WiFi and city

dudu_start_tasks.tooltip: Start periodic tasks: astronaut animation / message rotation / weather every 60 min / network check every 5 min / NTP sync every 58 min

dudu_sync_data.message0: Dudu clock sync initial data (NTP + weather + air)
dudu_sync_data.tooltip: Sync NTP time and fetch current weather, air quality and 7-day forecast once; retries on failure and reboots after 60 s
